briefTitle: Evaluate BL-B01D1 in Patients With Metastatic or Unresectable Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer (NSCLC) and Other Solid Tumors

typedChecks.sourceText: Age: ≥18 years
Has an Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group performance status (ECOG PS) 0 to 1
typedChecks.evidence_quote: Has an Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group performance status (ECOG PS) 0 to 1

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Has a life expectancy of ≥3 months
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Life expectancy is a subjective clinical judgment, not a typed lab or stage check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Has at least one measurable lesion based on RECIST V1.1 (with the exception of Prostate adenocarcinoma cohort, where subjects with bone metastasis are allowed)
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Measurable disease by RECIST is a subjective imaging judgment, not a typed kind.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Participants who have received prior therapy with any ADC targeting EGFR and/or HER3 or containing a topoisomerase 1 inhibitor payload (all dose expansion cohorts with exception of TNBC noted below).
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: The rule excludes multiple ADC classes and topoisomerase 1 inhibitors with specific cohort exceptions, which cannot be expressed as a single simple prior_therapy_excluded check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Participants treated with more than two systemic chemotherapies prior to randomization.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Participants with primary tumors in the central nervous system (CNS) and active or untreated CNS metastases and/or carcinomatous meningitis should be excluded. Participants with previously treated brain metastases may participate provided they are clinically stable for at least 4 weeks and have no evidence of new or enlarging brain metastases and no requirements for corticosteroids 14 days prior to dosing with the investigational product (IP).
